title: Production Infrastructure as Code with Modular Terraform, TFLint & LocalStack Cloud Emulation
problem: Software engineering teams managing cloud resources through ad-hoc manual console clicking or monolithic copy-pasted configuration files suffer from severe configuration drift, untracked security misconfigurations, and catastrophic accidental resource destructions. Furthermore, practicing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) against live cloud provider environments incurs unpredictable monthly billing, risks accidental credential leakage, and creates slow feedback cycles. This project builds a production-grade infrastructure-as-code automation platform in Terraform. The system provisions a multi-tier cloud topology (VPC, public/private subnets, ECS Fargate containers, Application Load Balancers, RDS PostgreSQL, and CloudWatch alarms) using reusable Terraform modules, enforces strict static linting and security scanning with TFLint and Checkov, validates state deployments offline on LocalStack, and executes automated plan/apply CI/CD workflows with zero cloud expenses.

use_cases.title: Multi-Environment Staging and Production Parity
use_cases.first_sentence: Enterprise software platform teams require identical infrastructure topology across staging, QA, and production environments.
use_cases.second_sentence: Parameterized Terraform modules deploy environment tiers with variable sizing while maintaining identical networking and security group topologies.

use_cases.title: Automated Pull Request Infrastructure Drift Detection
use_cases.first_sentence: DevOps teams need continuous verification that cloud resource states match declared Git repositories without out-of-band manual drift.
use_cases.second_sentence: Scheduled GitHub Actions workflows execute `terraform plan -detailed-exitcode` against LocalStack, alerting engineers immediately upon drift detection.

use_cases.title: Automated Security Compliance Policy Gate
use_cases.first_sentence: Security operations teams must ensure no S3 buckets are public and all database storage volumes are encrypted before infrastructure commits.
use_cases.second_sentence: Pre-commit Checkov and TFLint static analysis hooks inspect Terraform HCL code, automatically blocking commits that violate defined security standards.

hard_parts: Structuring reusable, composable Terraform modules (networking, compute, database, monitoring) with strict input type constraints and sensible default variables
Configuring LocalStack Docker container environments to emulate AWS VPC, ECS, RDS, and CloudWatch APIs with accurate resource attribute mappings
Integrating static analysis scanners (TFLint and Checkov) into pre-commit and CI/CD pipelines to catch security violations prior to deployment
Designing atomic remote state management strategies with S3 backend locking simulation and sensitive variable isolation
screener_signals: Clean Terraform codebase cleanly separating root environment entrypoints, reusable `/modules/` subdirectories, TFLint rules, and Checkov policy configs
Automated deployment benchmark report proving complete multi-tier infrastructure provisioning and verification in under 90 seconds on LocalStack
Anti-fake verification script attempting to commit an unencrypted RDS database and public ingress security group and asserting Checkov fails with exit code 1

architecture.data_flow: An engineer modifies an infrastructure parameter in `environments/staging/`; GitHub Actions triggers a CI workflow; TFLint and Checkov scan the Terraform code for syntax errors and security policy violations; if clean, the workflow initializes Terraform pointing provider endpoints to LocalStack at `http://localhost:4566`; `terraform plan` executes, generating an execution plan artifact; `terraform apply` applies the plan, creating the VPC, subnets, ECS Fargate cluster, RDS database, and CloudWatch alarms in LocalStack; automated verification scripts run health checks against the provisioned ALB endpoint; `terraform plan -detailed-exitcode` verifies zero drift.
architecture.enforcement_mechanism: Checkov policy rules blocking insecure HCL configurations; Terraform state locking preventing concurrent execution races.

environment.gpu: None required (purely CPU and local container bound IaC toolchains)
environment.cost: $0 (fully open-source stack using local Terraform CLI and Docker LocalStack)
environment.accounts_keys_quotas: No external AWS cloud accounts, credit cards, or paid service quotas required (runs 100% offline via LocalStack)

environment.fallback_path: Running `terraform validate` and `terraform plan` with mock provider credentials if Docker is unavailable

riskiest_component.name: State File Corruption and Concurrency Race Conditions
riskiest_component.mitigation: Configure S3 remote state storage with DynamoDB state locking simulation in LocalStack and enforce atomic apply workflows.
riskiest_component.fallback: Versioned state backup files enabling automatic state rollback.

worksheet.q3: 3 use cases: multi-environment staging/production parity, automated pull request drift detection, and security policy gates.
